title: Investigate why something is failing
trigger_text: debug an error, failing test, crash, or unexpected behaviour and find the root cause

body.instruction: Reproduce the failure directly and capture the exact error output — do not work from a paraphrase
Read the failing code path and the surrounding context; identify the specific line or condition that breaks
State one concrete hypothesis for the cause and the smallest check that would confirm or refute it
Run that check. If refuted, form the next hypothesis rather than guessing at a fix
Apply the minimal change that addresses the confirmed cause, then re-run the reproduction to confirm it's resolved

done_criteria: the cause is understood, not just the symptom suppressed
notes: Confirm the cause before changing code — a fix applied to an unconfirmed hypothesis often just moves the bug.
